purpose: Turn explicit authoring requirements into measurable preflight checks without pretending to judge artistic quality.

optional.footprint: Exact widthTiles/depthTiles requested for this asset; positive integers.
optional.requiredRoles: Semantic parts that must exist in visible, evaluated geometry.
optional.minDimensions: Minimum X/Y/Z world extent. Array of three non-negative numbers; null means unconstrained.
optional.maxDimensions: Maximum X/Y/Z world extent. Array of three non-negative numbers; null means unconstrained.

units: Blender world units; canonical production uses 3 units per tile.
